% A recursion cut inside a group that set \escapechar before it began:
% the cut widens only what the recursion wrote.
\def\zzloop{\zzloop\relax}
\begingroup\escapechar=-1 \zzloop\ifnum\escapechar=-1 \else\gdef\EscapeWidened{}\fi\endgroup
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
